title: Handle division by zero
message: A divide request crashes with ZeroDivisionError.
reproduce: uv run python -c 'from loop_engineering_example.app.api import handle_calculation; print(handle_calculation({"operation":"divide","left":10,"right":0}))'
acceptance_criteria: A divide request with right=0 returns {"error":"division by zero"}.
No raw ZeroDivisionError escapes the API boundary.
Existing successful operations keep their current behavior.

title: Add modulo support
message: The calculator rejects the required modulo operation.
reproduce: uv run python -c 'from loop_engineering_example.app.api import handle_calculation; print(handle_calculation({"operation":"modulo","left":10,"right":3}))'
acceptance_criteria: The modulo operation returns the remainder in the existing result envelope.
Modulo by zero returns {"error":"division by zero"}.
Existing operations keep their current behavior.

title: Add power support
message: The calculator rejects the required power operation.
reproduce: uv run python -c 'from loop_engineering_example.app.api import handle_calculation; print(handle_calculation({"operation":"power","left":2,"right":8}))'
acceptance_criteria: The power operation returns left raised to right in the existing result envelope.
Numeric validation matches the existing operations.
Existing operations keep their current behavior.
